newsitem.title: USA: PG&E names Rescoe chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: PG&E names Rescoe chief financial officer.

text.p: PG&E Corp announced on Thursday the appointment of Michael Rescoe as chief financial officer of the $26 billion diversified energy services company, effective September 1.
Immediately prior to his appointment at PG&E, Rescoe was chief financial officer with ENSERCH Corp, a Dallas-based natural gas distribution, pipeline, and independent power production company.
Prior to his assignment with ENSERCH, Rescoe was a senior managing director with Bear, Stearns & Co, responsible for the investment firm's utility and energy practice.
Rescoe succeeds Gordon Smith, who became chief executive officer of PG&E's utility subsidiary, Pacific Gas & Electric Co, on June 1 this year.
